cases.description: Headings in a block quote and in a list item are not sections, while a heading between `<details>` lines, after the blank line that ends the HTML block, is one (§5.3); so of `> ## Quill`, `## Quill`, `- ## Quill`, the `## Quill` between `<details>` lines and the last `## Quill`, the second gives `quill`, the fourth `quill-1` and the fifth `quill-2`, and GitHub, which numbers the headings in containers too, gives them `quill-1`, `quill-3` and `quill-4`.
